evals.input: Draft a contract for a $1,500 TikTok + Instagram deal with a creator. 1 TikTok video, 3 IG Stories. 30-day competitor exclusivity. We want to use the content in paid ads.
expect: Includes all deliverables with platform, format, quantity, due dates
Payment section specifies $1,500 with a payment structure (e.g. 50/50)
Usage rights section explicitly covers paid advertising use
Exclusivity clause specifies 30 days and asks for specific competitor names
Includes a disclaimer that this is not legal advice and recommends attorney review

evals.input: What's a fair kill fee for a creator contract?
expect: Explains the tiered kill fee structure (pre-draft vs. post-draft vs. post-live)
Gives specific percentage ranges (25–50% pre-draft, 50–75% post-draft)
Explains the logic: protects the creator's time while acknowledging the brand's right to cancel
